name: AppAgent
summary: Multimodal smartphone agent framework that learns app workflows from exploration or demonstrations and operates through taps and swipes.
description: MIT-licensed research framework for Android. Source setup uses Python requirements, Android Debug Bridge and a USB-debug-enabled device or Android Studio emulator. Configure model credentials in config.yaml; learning/exploration builds app knowledge used during deployment. AppAgentX is a separately linked successor. Model inference and device access are separate; an established project, not a newly released hosted API.

agent_access.notes: Public Python source; documented local setup requires Android/ADB and model-provider credentials.
